title.narrative: Local Liaison for East Java Water Cooperation

description.narrative: In support of the activities under the Partners for Water programme, The Water Agency provided Local Liaison (LO) support to strengthen water cooperation activities in East Java Province. From April 2023 to December 2024, the Local Liaison team of The Water Agency facilitated communication, coordination, and continuity across complex, multi-level stakeholder settings.The Local Liaison acted as a bridge between The Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO), provincial counterpart Public Works of Water Resource Agency (PUSDA) of East Java, executing consortia, national agencies, local governments, and societal actors. By leveraging long-standing relationships and in-depth contextual knowledge, the team reduced risks of miscommunication and enabled effective collaboration throughout project cycles. This role was particularly critical in addressing the irregular timelines of subsequent project assignments, ensuring sustained engagement, follow-up on deliverables, and preservation of institutional momentum beyond formal project closures.The Local Liaison support contributed directly to the successful initiation and implementation of two key projects: the Welang River Basin Transformation by Participatory Design (Phase II) and the Sidoarjo Fish Farmers Field School. Activities included stakeholder engagement, coordination of high-level visits and workshops, alignment with provincial and national planning processes, and regular reporting to RVO and PUSDA. The assignment strengthened trust, enhanced visibility of Dutch–Indonesian cooperation, and laid the groundwork for future, scalable collaboration in integrated water resources management and nature-based solutions in East Java Province.
